title: Emerging Scholars Forum 2027 | 19-20 January 2027 | Singapore - Singapore (SG) job with Nanyang Technological University, Singapore | 12866080
gist: A Nature Careers job listing (not a Nature Biotechnology article) for NTU Singapore College of Engineering's Emerging Scholars Forum 2027, a fully funded recruitment event for senior PhD students and postdocs. Its priority areas highlight AI for chemistry/materials, semiconductors, quantum, space and energy including nuclear and hydrogen.

insights.claim: NTU Singapore's College of Engineering is running an Emerging Scholars Forum on 19-20 January 2027, inviting senior graduate students and postdocs worldwide and fully covering selected participants' travel and accommodation, as a pipeline for faculty recruitment.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Signals Singapore's continued spending to attract global research talent to its engineering base.

insights.claim: Target recruitment areas explicitly include AI, machine learning and automation for chemistry, AI approaches for materials discovery and automated materials synthesis, and industrial AI.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: AI-for-science and self-driving-lab capabilities are a hiring priority at a top Asian engineering school.

insights.claim: Listed priority areas also cover semiconductor devices and IC design, quantum technologies, small satellites and space-based communications, and rocket propulsion and spacecraft design.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Indicates Singapore's strategic research bets in chips, quantum and space.

insights.claim: Energy-related hiring areas include renewables, smart grids and storage, marine, geothermal and nuclear energy, hydrogen and carbon management.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Nuclear and hydrogen appear alongside renewables in Singapore's energy research talent agenda.

insights.claim: Applications (CV plus two representative papers) are due 30 November 2026, while the listing's closing date shows 26 Nov 2026.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Minor administrative detail; inconsistency in posted deadlines.
